description: This file defines the 'NoteEditor' React component that provides a user interface for editing and saving a note, with features such as explicit save, auto-save on blur, visual confirmation, loading state, and deletion. It manages note state locally and interacts with an API for loading, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Main React component for editing a note, handling state, user interactions, and API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Effect hook to load note data if not provided initially.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Higher-order function to handle input changes for title and content fields.

methods.name: maybeBlurSave
methods.description: Function triggered on blur to save note after debounce if fields are dirty.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Function to perform an explicit save operation, with throttling to prevent rapid saves, optimistic UI updates, and error handling.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Function to delete the note and redirect to the notes list.
